name: Bounty Banner
desc: Show yourself to every rival for 2 minutes. Live through it: your dead squadmates return and you get 150 gems. Knocked, you go straight out and the knocker takes the gems. One per squad at a time.
src: docs/SOURCE_UTILITIES.md: 2 min reveal, a knock sends you to the deathbox and the knocker's side gets the bounty, survive for the squad revive
